display_name: Sleepiness Subscale: Number of items endorsed positively ("yes") (Range: 0-4)
description:
The sleepiness score is based on 4 items from the Pediatric Sleep Questionnaire. A higher score indicates more severe sleepiness. [Chervin et al, 2000 (PubMed ID: 10733617)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/10733617)

[Search for all PSQ variables within this dataset](https://sleepdata.org/datasets/pats/variables?search=psq)
